description: Get live fuel prices for about 10,000 gas stations across France (official open data, Hermès Revenu API). Use when comparing fuel prices, estimating route costs or building price datasets for France. Returns station objects with prices per fuel type. Pricing: $0.20 per run + $0.01 per 1k stations.
